headline: Kuhl Sells Playoff Lenny Just as the Party Starts
publicationDraft: Kuhl sold a reserve running back for DeVonta Smith, fresh off a 122-yard game. Stover dealt from a loaded receiving corps, and the move became crucial when Derrick Henry needed foot surgery in November. Fournette erupted for 40.60 in Stover's Week 12 victory over Kuhl, who got 3.20 from Smith. A December hamstring injury eventually sidelined Fournette, but the damage to Kuhl's trade return was already done. Smith had a respectable rookie season; the roster fit made sense for both managers. Stover simply bought the better asset at the right damn time.
